profileContract.rationale: plan defines common, server, client, data, state authority, and ownership boundaries
animation sampling, fixed seed generation, exact mapping, copy audit, and normalized artifacts are deterministic
reported and systematic failure classes have mandatory blocking behavior
supported Forge environment and unrelated loader, namespace, spawn, biome, and product exclusions are explicit
plan defines supplied assets, runtime behavior, commands, advancements, blocks, generated data, and release artifacts
ordered integration, tags, packaging, documentation, checksums, SBOM, and release closure are defined
logical side, untrusted data, artifact, dependency, and release boundaries are defined
entity state, replacement state, advancement compatibility, and save preservation are defined
unit, GameTest, runtime, multiplayer, fixed seed, visual, and artifact evidence are required
0.23 baseline, 0.24 target, stable ids, metadata, and compatibility are pinned

ownerDecisions.question: Are the supplied algae experimental or permanent 0.24 content
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner's clarification makes every supplied algae asset mandatory release content rather than an experiment.

ownerDecisions.question: How should duplicate shark discovery advancements be resolved
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: retire shark_whisperer and retain sharks_galore as the single all shark encounter advancement
ownerDecisions.rationale: One canonical discovery node removes duplicate progression while retaining both existing child branches.

ownerDecisions.question: How should advancement punctuation be normalized
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: preserve exact supplied title punctuation, normalize other titles without accidental terminal punctuation, and require exactly one grammatical terminal mark on descriptions
ownerDecisions.rationale: This preserves authored title intent while making all remaining advancement copy deterministic and testable.
